d.title: Ajin OVA
d.synopsis:
New episodes bundled with the limited edition eighth and ninth manga volumes.

OVA 1: The story surrounding the first domestic Ajin, "The Shinya Nakamura Incident."

OVA 2: Four humorous short stories from the points of view of Sato and Tanaka (2 stories), Izumi and Tosaki (1 story), and Ko and Kei (1 story).
